Driver Details

For use with systems equipped with AMD Radeon™ discrete desktop graphics, mobile graphics, or AMD processors with Radeon graphics. This tool is designed to detect the model of AMD graphics card and the version of Microsoft® Windows© installed in your system, and then provide the option to download and install the latest official AMD driver package that is compatible with your system. Download and run directly onto the system you want to update. An internet connection is required to run the tool. Learn More
